name: Pike Place Market
note: Pike Place Market Historical District (1971) and the waterfront below it: the Main Arcade with the Public Market sign and clock, the Corner, Sanitary and Economy markets, Post Alley, MarketFront and the Overlook Walk down to Elliott Bay.

rotateFrom.from: the Main Arcade along Pike Place (squared by hand; the downtown grid is 15.6 degrees off it)
